k.sel: Tableware and decorative glass makers named in Wikipedia's Category:Glassmaking_companies and its country pages for Austria, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Norway, Poland, Sweden, the United Kingdom and the United States, in List of defunct glassmaking companies, and in the Murano glass article. Flat-glass, container, optical, insulation, lighting, architectural, stained-glass and technical makers (Saint-Gobain, Pilkington, Schott AG, AGC and similar) are out of scope as not tableware; Japan's category lists only technical makers. Covers 101 houses, every tableware or decorative maker on those pages; a few defunct American pressed-glass firms are included as collected tableware. Series of Riedel, Zalto, Baccarat, Waterford, Iittala and Moser are versions.
